description: BASIC 7.0 warm start sequence: CLI, init vectors, jump to READY ($4D37)
Copy $0380-$03D4 common RAM stub, init $0300-$0313 vectors, Bank 0/1 pointers ($1C01, $0400, $FF00)
Print C128 BASIC V7.0 startup banner ($4107) and copyright messages
Set MMU $D501-$D504 preconfiguration registers ($3F, $7F, $01, $41) and sound/sprite state
Initialize VIC-II/SID shadow registers, default sprite colors, and scale factors
Check for autostart disk boot or cartridge before entering READY
85-byte template copied to $0380-$03D4 (CHRGET + Bank 0/Bank 1 indirect fetch routines)
Helpers for reading/comparing Bank 0 program text ($42D5/$42EC) and Bank 1 variables ($42E7)
Tokenize ASCII input line in $0200 into single-byte ($80-$FD), $FE-prefixed, and $CE-prefixed tokens
Primary keyword table (126 high-bit terminated strings for tokens $80..$FD)
$FE-prefixed extended statement keyword table (37 strings for $FE $02..$FE $26)
$CE-prefixed extended function keyword table (9 strings for $CE $02..$CE $0A)
Function dispatch table (40 direct 16-bit vectors: $B4..$D4 and $CE $02..$0A)
Operator precedence & RTS-1 dispatch table (10 3-byte entries)
LDX #$28; JMP $4D3C (UNIMPLEMENTED COMMAND error for OFF/QUIT)
41 high-bit terminated BASIC 7.0 error message strings (codes $01..$29)
Scan $484B error message table to error index A and set pointer ($26/$27)
Statement execution loop: poll STOP, trace line ($1216), advance TXTPTR ($3D/$3E)
Decode statement token ($80-$A2, $D5-$FA, or $FE $02-$26) and RTS-dispatch via $46FC
Bitwise 16-bit OR ($4C86) and AND ($4C89) operator evaluation
Common error stubs: OUT OF DATA ($0D), SYNTAX ($0B), DIVISION BY ZERO ($14), OUT OF MEMORY ($10)
Central error handler ($0300 IERROR): check TRAP ($1209), store ERRNUM ($120B), print ?...ERROR
Interactive input loop ($0302 IMAIN): read line, crunch ($430A), insert/delete Bank 0 program line or execute direct
Relink BASIC program lines in Bank 0 ($4F4F) and search for line number ($5064)
Manage 512-byte Software Control-Flow Stack ($0800-$09FF, TOS=$7D/$7E) for FOR/GOSUB/DO frames
Detokenize ($0306 IQPLOP) single-byte, $FE-prefixed, and $CE-prefixed tokens during LIST
Type-check routines: FRMNUM ($77D7), CHKNUM ($77DA), CHKSTR ($77DD), TYPE MISMATCH ($77E7)
Recursive operator-precedence expression evaluator using $4828 OPTAB
Evaluate single term/atom: literal number, string, variable, array, FN, or function token
Syntax check helpers: CHKCLS ')' ($7956), CHKOPN '(' ($7959), CHKCOM ',' ($795C), SYNCHR ($795E)
Locate or allocate 7-byte simple variable in Bank 1 RAM ($2F/$30..$31/$32)
Locate or allocate multi-dimensional array in Bank 1 RAM ($31/$32..$33/$34)
Upper BASIC ROM header jump table ($8000 JMP $4000, $8003 JMP $51F3)
Convert FAC1 to 16-bit signed integer ($84B4) and signed/unsigned 16-bit to FAC1 ($84C9/$84D4)
String allocation ($8690/$86CC), descriptor stack ($18..$21), concatenation ($86FF), FRESTR ($8781)
Evaluate 8-bit unsigned byte in X ($87F4 GETBYT) and 16-bit unsigned address in $16/$17 ($8812 GETADR)
Bank 1 dynamic string garbage collector using back-pointer marking
Formatted output engine for PRINT USING and PUDEF
VIC-II bitmapped graphics coordinate scaling, pixel plotting, line drawing, and $1C00-$3FFF memory relocation ($9F4F/$A022)
60 Hz raster/IRQ service for automatic sprite movement (MOVSPR), collision detection (COLLISION), and 3-voice PLAY/SOUND envelope engine
ML Monitor entry vectors: $B000 Cold Entry (JMP $B021), $B003 BRK Entry (JMP $B009), $B006 Cmd Parser (JMP $B0B2)
Save 8502 registers/bank to $02-$09 on BRK/entry and display PC SR AC XR YR SP header & values ('R' command)
Read command line into $0200, indirect via ($032E) to $B0B2, match 22 command characters in $B0E6, dispatch via $B0FC
Cross-bank memory read ($B11A -> INDFET), write ($B12A -> INDSTA), and compare ($B13D -> INDCMP)
Memory examine ('M' $B152) and modify ('>' $B1AB) in 8-byte (40-col) or 16-byte (80-col) rows
Compare ('C' $B231) and overlap-safe Transfer ('T' $B234) memory blocks across banks
Hunt ('H' $B2CE) for up to 32 hex bytes or ASCII string across bank memory
Disk/tape Load ('L'), Save ('S'), and Verify ('V') handler via KERNAL LOAD/SAVE
Fill ('F' $B3DB) memory range with byte value
Single-line 8502 assembler ('A' / '.' $B406): trial-disassemble opcodes $00-$FF to match mnemonic & operand pattern
8502 disassembler ('D' $B599, ';' $B61F) using packed 5-bit mnemonic tables ($B721/$B761) and mode table ($B770)
Multi-radix number parser ($ hex, + dec, & oct, % bin) producing 24-bit bank+address in $60-$62
Number base converter ($/+/&/% command at $B9B1): display value in hex, signed/BCD decimal, octal, and 24-bit binary
Disk status/command/directory ('@' $BA90) utility for IEC drives 4-30
